about: Source of every external initializer of llm_bidir_int4.onnx. kind 'copy': the safetensors tensor (cast to dtype) is written at offset. kind 'q4': the safetensors weight [N, K] (torch out x in, no transpose needed) is quantized to int4, blocks of 128 along K, symmetric, onnxruntime MatMulNBits layout: B uint8 [N, K/128, 64] (low nibble first, zero point 8) at B.offset and scales float32 [N, K/128] at scales.offset. 'embedded' initializers are small tensors stored inside the graph file; the rotary tables and all other constants are graph nodes, computed from the config at export time.
